definitions.explanation: The correct answer to a question, problem, or test. Implies solving or figuring out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{解答|かいとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The answers to the problems are on the back page.

examples.japanese: {解答|かいとう}⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name on the answer sheet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{内|ない}→内：09853_nai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全問|ぜんもん}→全問：27469_zenmon⟧{解答|かいとう}⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't answer all the questions within the time limit.

notes:
{解答|かいとう} refers to answers to problems, tests, or puzzles that require solving.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {解答|かいとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

Common collocations:
- {解答|かいとう}⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧ (answer sheet)
- {解答|かいとう}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (answer column/space)
- ⟦{模範|もはん}→模範：19610_mohan⟧{解答|かいとう} (model answer)
- ⟦{正|せい}{解|かい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧ (correct answer - abbreviation)

Homophone note:
- ⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧ (reply to inquiry) - same reading, different kanji

Distinction:
- {解答|かいとう} - solving problems/tests (解 = solve)
- ⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧ - responding to questions/surveys (回 = return)
